steps.label: nodes
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE OrderNodes(id INT64 NOT NULL,val INT64) PRIMARY KEY(id)

steps.label: graph
steps.sql: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH OrderGraph NODE TABLES(OrderNodes LABEL Node PROPERTIES(id,val))

steps.label: gql-value-ASC-all-r0
steps.sql: GRAPH OrderGraph MATCH(n) RETURN n.val AS value ORDER BY value ASC
